flows.result: Fourteenth header app opens the patient register within the healthcare shell
Register views/search/filters drive the API and survive reload (20 rows on first page)
Row opens the record; section deep link edits, saves with version, reload shows value and audit change
Duplicate warning, rules drawer jump and in-memory session draft restore including drawn signature
Empty save reveals problems; keyboard quick pick advances focus; complete registration assigns branch MRN and opens the record
Confirmed deactivate and reactivate through the status API with audit entries
Designer preview and save change the organisation layout; the form switcher saves it back
Arabic RTL and reduced motion from the shared preference API apply to every module route
